The '''Dantooine Incursion''' was an engagement between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[third Galactic War]], occurring around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" />

==Prelude==
During a [[Third Galactic War|third galactic conflict]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Republic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine]] was positioned in the edge of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] territory. It served as an ideal staging area for [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] travelling to the front lines.<ref name="TDI" />

Seeing its threat, the Sith Empire sought to attack Dantooine but were incapable of breaking the Republic's defenses in a direct assault.<ref name="TDI" /> [[Darth Xarion]], leader of [[Sith Intelligence]] and member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]],<ref name="Marauders" /> devised a plan for this purpose and hired the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group [[Nova Blades]] to attack the planet from within the Republic's own space.<ref name="TDI" />

The [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Lenora Trazen]], part of the [[Four-Hundred-Twenty-Fifth Special Infantry]], was assigned by [[Darth Malgus]]<ref name="Marauders" /> to lead the Empire's covert forces on the planet, as she was a strong advocate for destabilizing Dantooine.<ref name="TREP">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190503|text=Dantooine Tactical Report|int=Dantooine Tactical Report}}</ref>

By [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> the Republic garrison on the planet was led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Vindo]], with support from the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zai-Uram]].<ref name="Marauders" />

==The battle==
The Nova Blades' assault was relentless and caught the planet's garrison off-guard. During the chaos, the Empire was able to infiltrate their own elite force and establish a ground base.<ref name="TDI" /> With the pirates being unable to conquer the planet alone, the Imperial forces provided the needed manpower for both to wreak havoc across Dantooine.<ref name="TREP" />

As the incursion raged, the Nova Blades became more focused on plundering everything on the planet, regardless of faction affiliation which caused the pirates to start attacking Imperial forces.<ref name="Event">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190514|text=New In-Game Event - The Pirate Incursion}}</ref>

Later on, [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] arrived on Dantooine to assist the efforts of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Marauders" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Meanwhile, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Yarvok]] of the Nova Blades seized control of the [[Banir Regional Energy Complex|Dantooine Power Station]] and asked for 15 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]]. The power station was quickly besieged by Republic forces and a spacer would come to eliminate Yarvok and clear the building of Nova Blades.<ref name="RR">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=heroic|Reactor Ransom|Dantooine}}</ref>

The pirates deployed a [[prototype assault walker]] which they had stolen from an Imperial [[Factory/Legends|weapons-testing facility]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. A spacer was tasked to destroy the experimental vehicle before it could fall into the hands of either the Republic or Empire.<ref name="SNT">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=heroic|Shiny New Toy|Dantooine}}</ref>

Nova Blades were holding [[Slavery/Legends|slave auctions]] for selling those captured during their pillaging. One of such was guarded by the infamous [[exoboar]] [[Hugo (exoboar)|Hugo]] and terminated by an adventurous spacer.<ref name="Hugo">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=heroic|Beware Of Hugo|Dantooine}}</ref>

{{Endgame}}
